name: hgi_topk_w8c_rt_i-rti-COMMIT
purpose: Dedicated FIFO head output registers, same transaction edges/capacity, plus valid/ready receiver hold stages. Retains rt_f independent lane relays and accepted hard views. Current rt_f route preserved. model head_plan.json.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_idx_topk_w8_cluster u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic_20261009/ot_hgi_idx_topk_w8_hub.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic_20261009/ot_hgi_idx_topk_heap.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_topk_w8c_rt_i/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_topk_w8c_rt_i/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_topk_w8c_rt_i --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_idx_topk_w8_cluster --macro-view physical/ref_tile/hgi_topk_heap_rt_b/views/ot_hgi_topk_heap_tile --macro-view physical/ref_tile/hgi_topk_lane_rt_e/views/ot_hgi_topk_lane_tile > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: rt_i (Claude group-B4 10-14): the rt_h --cts gate (never routed) measured TT placement reg->reg -226 ps / in->reg -251 ps; classes (re-timed on the gate's 4_cts.odb): u_hub.core.k -> out_row / st / emitted / of -289 / -237 / -180 / -72 ps (the 12-b emitted != k compare in front of the root pop and every MERGE-exit / output-FIFO enable), st -> s_valid -126 (st == FILL decode into the wreg ingress), u_bo.pin_v -> active / c_valid / b_r -67..-38 (bfifo i_r = up && cnt + pin_v < 4 combinational into the wreg skid), g_rel en -> e0/e1 -63 (218 endpoints: fire was the load enable of 108 node data flops), rst_n port -> 11 relay RESETN across 1.3 mm -251. rt_i fixes each at the source, cycle-identical: (1) remaining count rem = k - emitted with REGISTERED rz (rem==0) / r1 (rem==1) flags, lr_q = (row+1 == m) registered, mrg_q = (st_n == MERGE); (2) fill_q = (st_n == FILL) registered from an explicit next-state st_n; (3) bfifo RIR=1 on u_bo: i_r is a register loaded with next-state occupancy (pop only picks); (4) merge node writes the free slot at wp whenever !pv (never read before the fire that fills it); (5) cluster reset: port -> one synchroniser at the pin (u_crp) -> 11-region relay. Benches: short 11 + full 16 cases PASS with CASE lines byte-identical to rt_h; BYP / CLR / REV / FIFO-head mutants FAIL. rt_h (Claude group-B r2/B3 10-14): rt_g routed TT -102.77 / FF -38.32 / DRC 0 with three logic-depth classes, each fixed at the source, cycle-identical (short bench CASE lines byte-identical to rt_g source): (1) out_ready -> u_bo head_d 13 levels: the bfifo next head is a 2:1 of two candidates formed from registered state only, o_r selects; (2) u_hub.core f1_c -> f2_gt 18 / f1_s -> f2_e 13 levels: lane keys (canon/mono/~index, NaN flag) formed in front of the F1 register from the boundary FIFO head and the cursor register, F1->F2 holds only the 53-b threshold compare; (3) relay g_rel en -> od 19 levels: the merge node head/spill pair (parent pop steering all 108 data loads) is a 2-entry pointer FIFO, data written once at wp, od a 2:1 by rp. Children (heap rt_b, lane rt_e) unchanged. Short exact PASS (11 cases), BYP/CLR/REV/FIFO-head mutants FAIL.
